name: manual.mixed_hostile_siege_mcw
description: Manual playtest handoff: dense midnight McWilliams siege with active bandit pressure, cannibal pressure, writhing stalker, zombie rider, flesh raptor, horde, and fire/smoke cues staged. The harness only loads the save and audits footing; it sends no gameplay keys after load.

steps.label: post_load_manual_mixed_siege_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: manual handoff loads onto the mixed hostile siege footing before the tester advances time

steps.label: audit_manual_mixed_siege_midnight
steps.abort_reason: saved game turn did not prove the intended midnight siege footing

steps.label: audit_manual_mixed_siege_bandit_job
steps.abort_reason: saved bandit_live_world state did not contain the active bandit pressure job

steps.label: audit_manual_mixed_siege_cannibal_job
steps.abort_reason: saved bandit_live_world state did not contain the active cannibal pressure job

steps.label: audit_manual_mixed_siege_monsters
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not contain the staged stalker, rider, and raptor

steps.label: audit_manual_mixed_siege_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved horde metadata did not contain the staged nearby zombie horde

manual_playtest.question: Does stacked hostile pressure create readable tension or incoherent noise?
tester_notes: Play from the loaded midnight state without trying to satisfy a proof contract.
Separate your impressions by actor group: bandits, cannibals, stalker, rider, raptor, horde, and camp NPCs.
Save after 5-15 minutes of in-game consequences if the aftermath state looks interesting.
metadata_to_check_after: saved bandit_live_world, active_monsters, and horde state

evidence_contract.claim: manual load starts from current staged mixed-siege footing without harness gameplay input
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: manual handoff footing only; gameplay feel comes from tester play after handoff
